sql.select: SELECT equipment_id, slot_type, name_key, home_image_path, photo_image_path, list_icon_image_path, detail_icon_image_path, is_initial_owned, sort_order FROM equipment ORDER BY sort_order, equipment_id;

SELECT equipment_id, slot_type, name_key, home_image_path, photo_image_path, list_icon_image_path, detail_icon_image_path, is_initial_owned, sort_order FROM equipment WHERE is_initial_owned = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, equipment_id;

SELECT equipment_id, slot_type, name_key, home_image_path, photo_image_path, list_icon_image_path, detail_icon_image_path, is_initial_owned, sort_order FROM equipment WHERE equipment_id = @equipment_id;
